trello.name: Create Stripe products and prices for subscription tiers
trello.desc: Set up Stripe products and recurring prices for Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers in Stripe Dashboard or via API. Basic: $29/month, Pro: $49/month, Enterprise: $99/month. Define metadata for feature sets for each tier. Acceptance criteria: All three products exist in Stripe, prices are recurring monthly, IDs are recorded in internal config/env for backend and frontend use.

trello.name: Build pricing page with tier comparison and checkout
trello.desc: Update the public pricing page to display Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with clear feature comparison table. Add prominent checkout buttons per tier. Integrate Stripe Elements for secure checkout form styled to match app design. Include tooltip/help icon explaining plan changes later. Handle checkout form errors gracefully for invalid card details and insufficient funds. Acceptance criteria: Pricing page renders correctly, Stripe Elements loads, checkout initiates for each tier, errors are user-friendly.

trello.name: Implement user dashboard subscription management UI
trello.desc: Build dashboard section showing current plan details, billing info, and real-time subscription status. Implement actions for upgrade, downgrade, cancel subscription, update payment method, and view invoices/payment history. Ensure UI updates in real-time after backend changes and shows notifications for successful upgrades or payment failures. Acceptance criteria: Dashboard displays correct plan, all actions work, status reflects webhook updates without manual refresh.

trello.name: Build backend Stripe subscription API integration
trello.desc: Implement backend services using Stripe API to create subscriptions on successful checkout, process payments, retrieve invoices, and manage customer payment methods. Expose internal API endpoints for frontend to create checkout sessions, confirm subscriptions, and manage plan changes. Acceptance criteria: API can create subscription, retrieve subscription status, process upgrades/downgrades/cancellations, and returns consistent responses.

trello.name: Implement Stripe webhook handlers
trello.desc: Set up webhook endpoint and handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. On payment_succeeded, activate/continue subscription in system. On payment_failed, update subscription status, notify user, and trigger email notification prompting payment method update. On subscription.deleted, revoke access rights and allow re-subscribe option. Ensure webhook verification and idempotency. Acceptance criteria: Webhooks process correctly in Stripe CLI tests, database updates match event, email sent on payment failure.

trello.name: Add frontend error handling and user notifications
trello.desc: Implement clear user notifications for subscription events including subscription confirmation, successful plan upgrade/downgrade, payment errors, and failed payments with instructions to fix. Integrate notifications with dashboard and checkout flow. Acceptance criteria: Users see actionable messages for all success and error states, no silent failures.

trello.name: Create and execute subscription test plan
trello.desc: Prepare detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for full subscription flow: sign-up, checkout, payment success/failure, upgrade/downgrade, cancellation, webhook handling, and dashboard updates. Include test scenarios for payment failures and cancellations using Stripe test cards. Acceptance criteria: Test plan document shared, all critical paths pass manual testing, automated tests cover checkout and webhook handlers.

trello.name: Write user documentation and FAQ for subscriptions
trello.desc: Create help section/FAQ covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, update payment methods, change plans, and troubleshoot common issues like payment failures. Include step-by-step instructions and links to dashboard. Acceptance criteria: Documentation is published and linked from pricing page and dashboard.

trello.name: Document backend API endpoints and webhook handlers
trello.desc: Document all internal API endpoints for subscription management and webhook event handlers with request/response examples, Stripe event mapping, and error handling notes for future maintenance and troubleshooting. Acceptance criteria: Documentation is complete in repo/wiki and reviewed by team.

trello.name: Coordinate integration timeline and follow-up
trello.desc: Track initial integration completion within two weeks and testing week thereafter. Schedule follow-up meeting for next week to review progress, unblock issues, and confirm frontend-backend integration alignment. Acceptance criteria: Timeline tracked, meeting scheduled, blockers escalated promptly.
